# Best AI Voice Agent Platforms: How to Evaluate Voice Automation

A practical evaluation guide for voice-agent platforms covering telephony, tools, handoff, latency, privacy and operational controls.

## Direct answer

Vapi documents a developer platform for voice agents that combines speech-to-text, an LLM and text-to-speech, supports inbound and outbound phone calls, and can call tools or external APIs. Yellow.ai documents voice as one channel in a broader enterprise customer-service platform. A responsible comparison therefore separates developer-centric voice infrastructure from broader enterprise-agent suites instead of collapsing them into one score.

## When this page is useful

Use this page to build a shortlist or implementation plan, not as a substitute for a vendor contract, security review or hands-on pilot. Compare the same workflow across candidates, keep the evidence date visible, and prefer reversible tests before production access is granted.

# Cursor vs Codex: Choosing an Agentic Coding Workflow

A current comparison of Cursor and OpenAI Codex based on workflow model, agent execution, environment, extensibility and team fit.

## Direct answer

Cursor and OpenAI Codex are both agentic coding systems, but their product surfaces differ. Cursor centers an editor plus cloud-agent workflow and documents extensions such as MCP servers, plugins, hooks and skills. OpenAI describes Codex as a coding agent available in ChatGPT and through the Codex app, designed for end-to-end engineering tasks, parallel agents, cloud environments, skills and scheduled work. pages.content:
# AI Agent Glossary: MCP, RAG, Tool Use, Agents and Related Terms

A concise glossary hub for core AI-agent concepts with definitions anchored to primary technical documentation.

## Direct answer

This glossary explains terms as they are used in modern agent systems. An AI agent combines a model with instructions, state and the ability to use tools or take actions. Tool use means the model can request a defined function rather than only generate text. RAG retrieves external information and supplies it to a model at inference time. MCP is an interoperability protocol for connecting clients to servers that expose tools, resources or prompts. Agent orchestration coordinates steps, agents, state and approvals across a workflow.

# How to Use Cursor AI: A Safe, Practical Workflow for Agentic Coding

A step-by-step workflow for using Cursor effectively while keeping repository scope, review, testing and cost controls explicit.

## Direct answer

A safe Cursor workflow starts with a small, well-scoped repository task. Open the project, describe the desired outcome and constraints, let the agent inspect only the files it needs, review its plan, and keep generated changes in version control. Run the project's tests and type checks before accepting edits. For long-running work, cloud agents can be useful, but repository permissions, secrets and CI behavior still need review. In India, Cursor Start provides a locally priced entry point for eligible developers.
